outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 241 women in labor with a full-term live fetus, dilatation of 6 to 8 cm, and cephalic presentation (vertex position)
finding: A non-episiotomy protocol showed no difference in maternal or perinatal outcomes compared to selective episiotomy.
mod_finding: The episiotomy rate was similar between the non-episiotomy group and the selective episiotomy group (about 1.7%).
